Help [[Melonni]] recruit a [[rare material trader]] for the Command Post.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites|campaign=Nightfall|nationality=any|hero=Melonni|unstarted=[[Koss Goes Recruiting]]}}

===Objectives===
* Recruit a rare material trader.
* Talk to Melonni.
* Escort Melonni to meet her contact in the [[Sunward Marches]].
* See [[Lonai]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s

==Walkthrough==
The easiest way to do this quest is starting from [[Dajkah Inlet (outpost)|Dajkah Inlet]]. Walk out to the north where the boss [[Eshim Mindclouder]] is located.  You might be able to run in and update the quest without fighting that group. Return to [[Sunspear Sanctuary]] once the quest updates itself as completed.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
*{{x}} 17 [[Jehrono]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Dunkoro'''
:''"We need a rare material trade for supplies if we're going to turn this makeshift dump into a field base. We can't very well go to [[Varesh]] or rely on the local [[Kournan]]s. I have a plan that just might work."''

:''"We need to recruit one of the [[corsair]]s to help us in our efforts. [[Koss]] should have a contact, or maybe Melonni can help us find a suitable recruit. So what do you say?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll find us a rare material trader.
|decline = Find your own merchants.
|ask = You will need to consult those who have joined our cause to complete this quest. Look to '''Koss''' or '''Melonni''' for guidance. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Melonni'''
:''"When [[Chuno]] and I were growing up, we knew a boy named Jehrono who was kidnapped by corsairs. If we could track him down, perhaps he would help us. I have heard a rumor he may be at Dajkah Inlet in the Sunward Marches. Perhaps if we poke around there we can find him."''

'''Jehrono'''
:''"Melonni! Is that really you? I haven't seen you in ages! My, you've grown into a stunning young lady!"''
:''"What have I been up to? As a matter of fact, I run my own trading outfit now and deal in rare items and materials. But it is becoming harder and harder these days to trade with Istan with the storms and such. I need some steady work."''
:''"I got into some trouble with [[Ruthless Sevad]], so a "vacation" of sorts could be good for me. How is Chuno, by the way? Still thumping his chest like a goon?"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Lonai'''
:''"Corsairs? I'm worried that we're relying on some less-than-honorable allies. At least with a rare material trader we can craft stronger armor for the coming fight."''

==Notes==
*Dunkoro also offers the quest [[Koss Goes Recruiting]]. You can only choose one of the 2 quests, since the other will then become unavailable.
*After completion of this quest, [[Jehrono]] will appear in the Command Post as an additional [[material trader]] [[NPC]].
{{Anomaly|Although Jehrono is labeled as a rare material trader, he acts like a normal material trader. However, this bears no significance to the function of the Command Post since both types of material traders are already present.}}
